agents.name: Claude Code
agents.role: primary, anything whose output is code

surface_source.quote: I never have this need, because I just kick off the task directly on mobile and it runs in a cloud session without using my local environment — I think because I’m doing very easy coding tasks.

agents.quote: Claude Code is where I build prototypes, evals, and scripts, many of which call Claude API. I use this when the output is code.

agents.name: Claude Tag
agents.role: first pass on new features, in Slack
agents.quote: Maybe I say, “Hey, I think we should implement this new feature in Cowork,” and I’ll tag in Claude Tag to do a first pass at it.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.quote: I’ve been using Opus 5.5 as a daily driver and love its clear communication skills and ability to write in my style.

history.quote: These projects took hundreds of hours of prompting Claude Code powered by Sonnet 3.5 (new), but not a single line of code written by hand.
I've mostly switched from Fable 5.1 to Opus 5.5 because I like it's clear communication.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.quote: I still turn to Fable 5.1 for my "fire and forget" coding tasks.

review_style.value: Claude code review clears the outer layers; code owners review the core
review_style.quote: But increasingly, for the changes at the outer layers, we actually have Claude code review fully review those.

also.quote: For the most critical changes to the core of Claude Code, and the cores of other products, there is always a code owner and they do manually review all the changes.

harness.value: Auto mode; tasks kicked off from mobile into cloud sessions
harness.quote: But for a lot of us who are on auto mode right now — hopefully you’re not on YOLO mode — I don’t think it actually matters, and we could probably just remove file edit and be totally fine.

history.quote: I would read every permission prompt extremely carefully.

hooks.quote: yes! i use it to write my permission approval hooks :)

signature.caption: reset at every model launch
signature.why: Our pick: she tests each new model on a clean slate instead of carrying old tweaks forward.
signature.quote: I generally reset my configs for each new model

archetype.why: Resets her configs for each model and leans on built-ins: auto mode, the guide agent, Claude code review.

signature_quote.value: I feel like we’ve all gotten a chance to take a step back and delegate a lot more of the menial implementation to Claude.
signature_quote.more: It’s freed up a lot of our time to think about more creative work, like: what is the right experience that we should be providing to our users, now that we know Claude Code can implement a lot of it?
